$schema_note: Vanguard-specific retinue tuning (task-005), closing the 'Vanguard retinue tuning: growth rate, attrition, per-floor cap' item in RTS-VERTICAL-SLICE.md §4 / SYSTEMS.md §6. Two new tables (danger_index, rescue_and_rally) are this doc's own additions, computed strictly from named cells in docs/data/encounter-budget.json and docs/data/entity-tiers.json (composition, DPS, risk-room bonus counts) plus one calibration anchor also cited from encounter-budget.json (rank_arrival_context.gate1_calibration_wave1). expected_losses[] and the three_floor_ledger[] derive from those two tables. starting_headcount is the one input sourced outside those two files (docs/data/economy.json slice_targets.start_units, cross-checked against encounter-budget.json's own peak_concurrency_check[0].RetinuePeak, which independently agrees at 40) -- see design doc §1 for why. growth_site_context[] is explicitly OUT of the strictly-sourced boundary (sourced from docs/data/growth-sites.json, unmodified, shown for comparison only, never substituted into three_floor_ledger[]). Decisions + rationale: docs/design/retinue-tuning-vanguard.md. Columns/units/ranges: retinue-vanguard.schema.md.

design_constants.starting_headcount_source: docs/data/economy.json slice_targets.start_units (Militia tier). Cross-checked, not re-derived: docs/data/encounter-budget.json peak_concurrency_check[0] (floor1_peak) RetinuePeak is also 40 -- independent agreement between two already-committed files.
design_constants.starting_headcount_status: SOURCED OUTSIDE encounter-budget.json/entity-tiers.json -- the one stated exception, see design doc §1.
design_constants.rescue_conversion_rate_status: JUDGMENT CALL, this doc's own first-pass dial -- same status as Swarm.PulseLullSeconds/Swarm.EliteLeadSeconds in encounter-budget.json. NOT derived from anything measured.
design_constants.rescue_conversion_rate_note: Proposed Vanguard.RescueConversionRate. Fraction of a cleared Risk Room's BonusFodderCount (encounter-budget.json risk_room_budget[]) converted to rescued Freed-tier retinue, reframing that room's existing pure-Fodder reward as guarded captives for the Vanguard specifically (CLASSES.md §1 'rescue sites... freeing them = recruiting them'). Additive to the room's existing loot/Ember reward -- does not change or replace it.

calibration_anchor.danger_index_source: docs/data/entity-tiers.json tiers[brood_fodder].DPS -- the anchor scenario is pure Fodder (no Soldier tiers existed at GATE1 measurement time)
calibration_anchor.measured_losses_source: docs/GATE1-FUN-PROTOTYPE.md §3b, 'shipped defaults, measured (4 zero-input runs)' row: 109-111 of 120 retinue survive wave 1. Required reading per task-005's brief, cited exactly, not re-simulated (docs/sim/LIMITATIONS.md §1 -- the harness cannot reproduce this baseline at its committed defaults).

design_constants.expected_losses_formula: DangerIndex(floor) = sum_tier(PulseCount_tier(floor) * DPS_tier) / Population(floor). ExpectedLosses(floor) = LossesAnchor * (Population(floor) * DangerIndex(floor)) / (PopulationAnchor * DangerIndexAnchor). PulseCount_tier(floor) sums docs/data/encounter-budget.json pulse_schedule[] rows for that floor; DPS_tier is docs/data/entity-tiers.json tiers[].DPS.
design_constants.expected_losses_caveat: Scales ABSOLUTE losses by total floor danger (population x per-capita DPS), not by defending headcount -- a stated limitation given exactly one measured calibration point exists (fitting a second free parameter for headcount-sensitivity would be curve-fitting noise, not data). See design doc §3.1 and §8 (bimodal caveat) -- likely optimistic at low headcount, not just imprecise.

three_floor_ledger_verdict: STARVE -- Rescue & Rally alone does not keep pace with combat losses (35 -> 26 -> 13 across the slice). By design a supplement, not a replacement, for the growth-site Recruit lane -- see growth_site_context[] below. Also see design doc §8: §3's loss model is likely optimistic (not conservative) at these headcounts, per GATE1-FUN-PROTOTYPE.md's own measured bimodal collapse behavior at gentler population ratios than floor 1 already starts at.

growth_site_context.status: OUT OF THE STRICTLY-SOURCED BOUNDARY -- sourced from docs/data/growth-sites.json (unmodified, existing SYSTEMS.md §7 economy). Shown for comparison only; never substituted into three_floor_ledger[] above. See design doc §5/§6b.

per_floor_soft_cap.rule: No hard numeric cap (Design Law 2). Governed entirely by the existing Supply/upkeep degrade mechanic (economy.json, unchanged): rescued units draw the same uniform 1 upkeep/unit as any recruited unit but cost 0 Embers, so Rescue & Rally is a free version of the 'upkeep-hungry' Recruit lane (SYSTEMS.md §7). Practical per-floor ceiling on how much Rescue headcount is worth taking = wherever Supply capacity (Provision-funded, unchanged) runs out relative to demand -- a soft, play-driven ceiling, not a new number this doc adds.
per_floor_soft_cap.worked_example: Rescuing all three floors (5+9+14=28 units) without ever spending Embers on Provision adds 28 to Supply demand for zero Ember cost -- degrades the WHOLE army (uniform upkeep, economy.json) once demand exceeds capacity, not just the newly-rescued units.
